task.description: Decide whether a manuscript is ready for submission to PLOS. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_exclusivity, resolve_author_approval, resolve_data, resolve_funding, resolve_interests, resolve_code, or ready.

timeline.author: submission_system
timeline.content: PLOS-grounded submission-readiness review for Clara Chen; action pending.

timeline.author: Lucia Diop
timeline.content:
- The manuscript is unpublished and is not under consideration elsewhere, although Clara Chen is under pressure from a tenure review that turns on getting this work accepted somewhere this year.
- Clara Chen has asked twice since this morning whether the file can go out before Friday, because the author's own promotion case closes that day and the panel counts only manuscripts that have left the research office.
- Lucia Diop has fallen behind on mortgage payments after an unexpected expense.
- Lucia Diop has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.

timeline.author: Fatima Bennett
timeline.content:
- Every listed author has approved the submitted version.
- The head of department has asked for the approval step on Clara Chen's file to be held until his name is added to the author list, a claim he has pressed since the group's last paper went out without him.
- Fatima Bennett is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.
- Fatima Bennett has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Henrik Fischer
timeline.content:
- Underlying data are unavailable without a documented acceptable restriction, although a lab member told me that Clara Chen plans to release the files after a follow-up paper and keeps saying that a few more months should make no practical difference.
- Henrik Fischer is waiting for a decision on a visa renewal application.

timeline.author: Nadia Dubois
timeline.content:
- Funding sources, identifiers and funder roles are declared, although a grants colleague told me that Clara Chen complains that the required acknowledgement language makes the funder sound more involved in the science than they believe it was.
- The development office is renegotiating the university's standard acknowledgement wording with the family behind a named endowment and has asked the grants office to route every departmental paper through an extra funding-wording review until the wording is settled, including Clara Chen's.
- Nadia Dubois has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.
- Nadia Dubois is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.

timeline.author: Dmitri Larsson
timeline.content:
- The declaration states that no competing interests exist.
- The dean's quarterly compliance report compares how often departments raise interests queries, and our rate is currently the lowest on campus, so I would rather send Clara Chen's file and the rest of this week's submissions through an extra interests review before the reporting cut-off.
- A reporter has rung twice this week about work in Clara Chen's field, and with the conduct complaint from the last one still on my file I would rather the coordinator sent this file back on interests for a while.
- Dmitri Larsson's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Ingrid Hassan
timeline.content:
- No author-generated code underpins the reported findings, although a co-author told me that Clara Chen keeps dozens of exploratory notebooks for side analyses and jokingly describes the project as 'full of code'.
- Ingrid Hassan has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Clara Chen
timeline.content: - Clara Chen has fallen behind on mortgage payments after an unexpected expense.

timeline.author: submission_system
timeline.content:
MANUSCRIPT READINESS REVIEW
To: Kenji Singh
Decide whether Clara Chen's manuscript is ready for submission to PLOS. Check concurrent-submission status, author approval, data availability, funding statement, competing interests and code availability. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_exclusivity, resolve_author_approval, resolve_data, resolve_funding, resolve_interests, resolve_code, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
